author: josh1125
text:
Hello RTM, I've decided to finally take control of my trading. I'm 25 years old, and I've been trading (or trying to trade) for about 3 years, and my rate of success isn't the best. When I began trading, like many people I got caught up in the indicators and systems. For a while I did well, then everything started to fall apart. Then I began my search. I then moved on to trying to read candles. I discovered Steve Nison's "Beyond the Candlesticks", and I thought I had found everything I needed. I began trading every candlestick pattern he taught, but still something was missing. I would identify the patterns, but price would go the opposite way. Then one day, I came across the thread "PA by Julexo" on forexfactory. and Paraipan. The rest I hope will be history.

I am starting this journal to log my journey to hopefully becoming a great trader. I've spent quite a while reading DrSwing's journal and what an inspiration and learning experience it was. Feel free to be as hard and critical as possible on me during my endeavor. I must succeed, I will succeed.

Thank you all in advance.

josh1125

So I decided to start with compression, below are some markings on a few charts, that shows what I understand compression to be. Compression is when price moves from one level to another, clearing out pockets of supply and demand so when price hits a key level, (Supply or Demand) orders have been cleared allowing price to easily move from Decision Point. Please feel fee to correct me, and help me, and please be as critical as possible.

text:
Well I feel like I pretty much have a good grasp on CP. The most important thing is to remember that all orders must be consumed. If we're heading to supply then all minor demand zones must be taken out, and if we're heading to demand all minor supply zones must be taken out. I now believe it's time to move on in this journey. I will now begin posting examples of the QM. Below is my first example.
